resources.string: Next reel/short on keyboard swipe, Speed Key shortcuts, Convenience key actions.

Fixes the BlackBerry KEY2 keyboard on LineageOS:

• In the apps you choose (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok…), a swipe on the keyboard flips to the next or previous video instead of scrolling half way.
• Speed Key (3×3 dots) + letter opens your shortcuts, like on BlackBerry's software.
• Convenience key press, hold and double press run actions you pick.

The service watches key presses and keyboard swipes only to do this, reads which app is in front, and plays touch gestures. It does not collect or send any data.
Off. Tap, open \"KEY2 Keyboard Fixer\" and turn it on.

Needed for the Convenience key: LineageOS turns it into an \"Assist\" key that only the digital assistant receives. Tap → Digital assistant app → KEY2 Keyboard Fixer.

This ROM turns keyboard swipes into mouse-wheel scrolling, and video feeds don\'t snap to the next video on wheel scrolling. In the apps below a swipe on the keyboard becomes a real screen swipe: swipe up on the keyboard for the next video, down for the previous one. While you type (a text field is focused) the keyboard works normally.
Needs Android 14 or newer and the accessibility service
Tap an app to switch it on or off. Keyboard swipes in checked apps become screen swipes; other apps keep the ROM\'s normal keyboard scrolling.
